posts.text: Studds Accessories (listed 2025 ) is showing a classic “top-line growth versus margin compression” setup in their Q2 & H1 FY27 results from the “xxx.pdf” presentation. Here is the simplified breakdown. The Good: Growth & Premiumization Revenue Growth: H1 FY27 revenue is up 16.2% YoY to ₹352.8 crores . Export Surge: Export revenue jumped 49.2% YoY , with export average selling prices rising from ~₹1,600 in FY24 to ~₹2,000 . Capacity Boost: A new manufacturing facility commenced production in October 2026, adding 1.5 million units of capacity to fuel further expansion . The Bad: Crushed Margins…
